_comment: Curated orthographic-convention register consumed by scripts/derive-orthographies.mjs.
One entry per language code, keyed by ISO 15924 script code. Each script entry may set
scheme / longVowelMarking / canonicalForMt and MUST set a source string that cites a
verifiable basis (on-card prose, a tool the card already lists, or a published convention).
Only add entries whose convention is actually documented — absence means unknown, and the
deriver writes nothing it cannot cite (index, not arbiter). Do NOT record measured scores here.
Data-over-code (docs/AGENTS.md §1): language-specific conventions live in this file,

Latn.source: manual-curation (SRO = Standard Roman Orthography; long vowels marked with circumflexes as used by itwêwina/ALTLab and the GiellaLT lang-crk FST the card lists in resources.fsts; reference lexicon: Wolvengrey 2001, nēhiýawēwin: itwēwina / Cree: Words; the card's own formality prose names SRO as the working script)

Cans.source: manual-curation (Syllabics is the display script, SRO the working script — per the card's own formality prose and the crk scriptConverter)
